domain_symbols.programming: formal laws governing programming language semantics and safety
domain_symbols.symbolic: symbolic expressions used by this domain

rules.name: Referential transparency
rules.input_form: pure expression e with no side effects
rules.output_form: e evaluates to same value in all contexts with same bindings
preconditions: No mutable global state read during evaluation
rules.operation: Substitute equals for equals without changing program meaning.
counterexamples: rand(), time(), unchecked IO in pure context
common_errors: Caching impure calls as if pure

rules.name: Rust ownership move semantics
rules.input_form: value v of owned type T moved to binding x
rules.output_form: previous owner of v becomes invalid; exactly one live owner
preconditions: No Copy trait unless bitwise duplicate is safe
rules.operation: Enforce single-owner memory discipline at compile time.

rules.name: Python LEGB name resolution
rules.input_form: identifier x referenced in nested scope
rules.operation: Resolve free variables by static nesting chain.
counterexamples: Unqualified assignment creates local without global decl

rules.name: JavaScript prototype chain lookup
rules.output_form: walk [[Prototype]] until p found or null
rules.operation: Delegate property resolution along prototype links.

rules.name: Go goroutine CSP concurrency
rules.input_form: go f(); channel ch with typed sends/receives
rules.output_form: independent lightweight thread + synchronized message passing
preconditions: Scheduler multiplexes goroutines onto OS threads
rules.operation: Share memory by communicating, not communicate by sharing.
counterexamples: Unsynchronized map writes across goroutines race

rules.name: C undefined behavior boundary
rules.input_form: operation outside ISO C standard guarantees
rules.output_form: compiler may assume UB never happens; any behavior permitted
preconditions: No sanitizers catching violation at runtime
rules.operation: Treat UB as non-existence for optimization.

rules.name: Zig comptime evaluation
rules.input_form: expression marked comptime or known at compile time
rules.output_form: evaluated during compilation; result embedded in binary
preconditions: All inputs to comptime block are compile-time known
rules.operation: Execute subset of language at compile time for zero-cost generics.

rules.name: WebAssembly structured control flow
rules.input_form: block, loop, if with result type
rules.output_form: stack-polymorphic validation; branches only to enclosing constructs
rules.operation: Guarantee verifiable sandboxed execution without arbitrary goto.
counterexamples: Unstructured branch to arbitrary label rejected
common_errors: Stack type mismatch at block end

rules.name: Lean dependent type checking
rules.input_form: term t : A where A may depend on values
rules.output_form: definitional + propositional equality checked by kernel
preconditions: Kernel accepts only certified proof terms
rules.operation: Reject ill-typed programs before they enter trusted corpus.

rules.name: Halting problem undecidability
rules.output_form: no general algorithm decides if P halts on x
rules.operation: Limits total automatic verification; motivates conservative analysis.
counterexamples: Total languages on bounded domains may decide
common_errors: Claiming 100% zero-day detection for all programs

rules.name: Type soundness preservation
rules.output_form: evaluation step preserves typing; progress or stuck on value
rules.operation: Well-typed programs do not go wrong (Milner).

rules.name: FSOTB trinary opcode totality on finite tape
rules.input_form: FSOTB program with bounded register file
rules.output_form: each opcode maps register state to successor within 27-trit word
rules.operation: Deterministic scalar evolution on trinary hardware motif.
common_errors: Mixing ABI tiers without version gate

rules.name: Code-genome codon stability hole
rules.output_form: connective_failure hole flagged; risk tier elevated
rules.operation: Detect structural illness analog in program token layout.
common_errors: Treating hole detection error as misprediction

rules.name: Immutability default in functional cores
rules.output_form: x cannot be reassigned; new binding shadows in inner scope
preconditions: Language without mutable let by default
rules.operation: Reduce aliasing bugs via single-assignment discipline.

rules.name: Capability security object-cap model
rules.output_form: holder of cap may invoke operation; no ambient authority
preconditions: No global root privilege without explicit cap
counterexamples: setuid root binaries with broad filesystem access
common_errors: Passing raw file paths instead of sealed handles
